metadata.description: Plan to implement visual style extraction system that captures design patterns (modern, brutalist, minimalist, neon) from websites and generates temporary themes for HoloDeck and Workbench
metadata.context: Complete implementation plan for style extraction feature

metadata.description: Interface defining extracted visual data from websites: colors (primary, secondary, background, text, accent, palette), typography (headingFont, bodyFont, headingWeight, bodyWeight), spacing (density, borderRadius, padding), effects (shadows, gradients, animations, glassmorphism, noise), metadata (favicon, logo, siteName)
metadata.context: Type definition for style extraction output

metadata.description: Interface for classified design patterns: id, name, category (modern, brutalist, neon, classic, playful, corporate, artistic, minimalist, retro, futuristic), confidence (0-100), characteristics[], description
metadata.context: Type definition for LLM-classified design patterns

metadata.description: Interface extending ThemeConfig with temporary theme metadata: id, source (website-extraction), sourceUrl, designPattern, isTemporary (true), createdAt
metadata.context: Type definition for themes extracted from websites

metadata.description: New file server/styleExtractor.ts for main style extraction logic. Functions: extractStyleFromUrl(), parseCSSProperties(), extractColors(), extractTypography()
metadata.context: Server-side module for extracting styles from URLs

metadata.description: New file server/designPatternAnalyzer.ts for LLM-based pattern analysis and classification. Functions: analyzeDesignPattern(), generateThemeFromPattern()
metadata.context: Server-side module for classifying design patterns

metadata.description: New React component client/src/components/ExtractedStyleSelector.tsx for displaying extracted styles. Shows preview of extracted themes, allows multiple selection
metadata.context: UI component for selecting extracted styles

metadata.description: New React hook client/src/hooks/useExtractedStyles.ts for managing extracted styles in session. Functions: temporary cache, selection, theme application
metadata.context: State management hook for extracted styles
